name: Supplier DO Report - Detail
query:
SELECT
    pr.name AS "PR No:Link/Purchase Receipt:150",
    DATE_FORMAT(pr.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'PR Date',
    pri.purchase_order AS "PO No:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    DATE_FORMAT(po.transaction_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'PO Date',
    pr.supplier_name AS "Supplier Name:Data:200",
    pr.status AS "Status:Data:100",
    
    -- MODIFIKASI: Gabungan Code - Name - Brand
    -- Tipe diubah ke :Data karena ini bukan lagi ID unik untuk Link
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', pri.item_code, pri.item_name, i.brand) AS "Item Code / Item Name / Brand:Data:250",
    
    pri.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    pr.currency AS 'Ccy',
    pri.rate AS "Price:Currency/ccy:120",
    pri.amount AS "Total:Currency/ccy:120"
FROM
    `tabPurchase Receipt` AS pr
JOIN
    `tabPurchase Receipt Item` AS pri ON pri.parent = pr.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabPurchase Order` AS po ON po.name = pri.purchase_order
-- JOIN BARU: Mengambil data Brand dari master Item
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem` AS i ON i.name = pri.item_code
WHERE
    pr.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    pr.posting_date ASC, pr.name ASC;
